verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say Gitea Actions workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions. They also say users can reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions without rewriting, actions can be downloaded from any Git site, and an official runner is provided. That directly covers reusing another platform's workflows and community actions. missing for 10: in-depth docs on compatibility limits or unsupported features, independent or hands-on confirmation that existing GitHub workflows run unmodified.
